WE, THE PEOPLE OF INDIA, solemnly resolve to secure liberty and equality.
PART III
FUNDAMENTAL RIGHTS
19. Protection of certain rights regarding freedom of speech, etc.
(1) All citizens shall have the right—
(a) to freedom of speech and expression;
(b) to assemble peaceably and without arms;
(2) Nothing in sub-clause (a) shall affect the operation of any existing law imposing reasonable restrictions.
Provided that the restriction is imposed by law.
Explanation I.— This explanatory sentence is included to exercise separate explanatory blocks.
21. Protection of life and personal liberty.
No person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law.
For the reference-extraction fixture, see Article 19.
